items.body: Switching to partition search introduces owner-specific results, but the similarity callers still map results by `mirrorHash`, ignoring `documentIds`. Documents sharing content can have different title-conditioned embeddings. In an in-memory reproduction, search returned beta’s vector with `documentIds: [2]`, but REST returned unembedded `zeta.md` (ID 4, same mirror, different title) with beta’s score of `0.99388`. CLI and MCP retain the same unsafe mapping assumption.
items.suggestion: Preserve `documentIds` when mapping partition results and calculating document scores across all three callers. Use hash-only mapping for legacy results without owner IDs. Add regression coverage for shared content with distinct titles and an unembedded owner.
